name: Freddy Yeti
source:
You might think of this monstrous giant as a big ice meanie, but he's anything but! Freddy welcomes all comers to sample his wares, whether leftovers, fresh veggies, or even just to stare blankly at his insides several times a day. He thinks you're the coolest of cool kids.
Likes: Food, Preservation, Food Preservation
Dislikes: Anything Uncool

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
